topography.project_purpose: Yield. Structurally: 74 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 1 ERC4626 vault, 31 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 10 common project-authored base contract(s) (clonable, dtoken, dtokenbase). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
